content.rendered:

– Multiplayer which can be enjoyed using Bluetooth.
– Updated transfer list , with updated rooster.

– New soundtracks.

How to download and install PBA 2K17 Apk + Obb

To download and install PBA 2k17, you need to follow the steps below.

•  Download >> PBA 2k17.apk

•  Download obb file here >> PBA Obb

•  Download zachiver for android to extract the obb file

•  Extract the obb file to sdcard/android/obb folder using zarchiver

• Finaly install PBA 2k17.apk application from where you save it and open it to start playing your game.
